newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle steady at $68, slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle steady at $68, slow - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said.

Inquiry and demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 2,800 slaughter steers and 700 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 96,700 head confirmed including 11,600 head or about 12 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 68.00; pen Select with end Choice 1225 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1050 lbs 67.00-68.00.
